surah_info.name_meaning: Al-Fatihah ka matlab hai 'The Opening' ya 'The Opener' — yani woh cheez jo kisi cheez ko kholti hai. Isko 'Fatihatul Kitab' bhi kaha jata hai, yani Kitab (Quran) ka iftitah/opening.
surah_info.introduction: Surah Al-Fatihah Quran ki pehli surah hai aur isme 7 ayat hain. Ye Makki surah hai — yani Hijrat se pehle Makkah mein nazil hui. Isko Ummul Quran (Quran ki maa) aur Ummul Kitab (Kitab ki maa) kaha jata hai kyunki isme Quran ke bunyadi themes — Tauheed, Risalat, Akhirat, Ibadah, aur Hidayat — sab summarized hain.
surah_info.what: Ye surah ek dua aur ek declaration hai. Isme bandah Allah ki tareef karta hai, uski rububiyat aur rahmat ka iqrar karta hai, Akhirat ke din ka malik hone ka aitraf karta hai, phir sirf uski ibadat aur usse madad maangne ka elaan karta hai, aur akhir mein hidayat ki dua karta hai.
surah_info.why: Ye surah har namaz ki har rakat mein padhi jati hai. Agar koi ise nahi padhta to uski namaz nahi hoti — ye hadith mein aaya hai. Ye surah banda aur Allah ke darmiyan ek mukalma hai, jaisa Hadith Qudsi mein Allah ne farmaya: 'Maine namaz ko apne aur apne bande ke darmiyan do hisson mein baant diya hai.'
surah_info.when_where: Jumhur (majority) ke nazdeek ye surah Makkah mein nazil hui, aur ye Quran ki sab se pehli mukammal surah hai. Kuch riwayat mein iska Madinah mein bhi nazil hona zikr hai, lekin ye zaeef hai. Iska waqt Nabuwwat ke shuruati daur (early Makkan period) hai.
surah_info.how_to_study: Is surah ko padhte waqt khud ko namaz mein khada samjho. Har ayat ko Allah ka jawab samjho. Jab tum 'Alhamdulillahi Rabbil Alamin' kehte ho, Allah farmata hai 'Mere bande ne meri tareef ki.' Jab tum 'Ihdinas Siratal Mustaqim' kehte ho, Allah farmata hai 'Ye mere bande ke liye hai aur use wohi milega jo woh maangta hai.' Ye ek zinda mukalma hai.
surah_info.known_vs_debated: Known: Surah ki 7 ayat hain, ye Makki hai, ye namaz mein farz hai. Debated: Bismillah ko alag ayat maanna ya nahi — Kufi qaris aur jumhur ise alag ayat maante hain, jabki kuch fuqaha ise surah ka hissa maante hain lekin alag ayat nahi. Iska asar namaz mein Bismillah ki recitation par padta hai.

sections.title: Allah ki Tareef aur Sifaat
sections.theme: Allah ki zaat, uski rahmat, aur uski rububiyat ka iqrar.
sections.flow: Bismillah se shuru hota hai, phir Alhamdulillah, phir Rahman aur Rahim, phir Malik-e-Yawm ad-Din. Banda Allah ki taraf mutawajjah hota hai.
sections.summary: Ye hissa Allah ki tareef hai. Pehle uske naam se shuru, phir uski tamam tareefein, phir uski rahmat, phir uska akhira ke din par ikhtiyar. Ye Allah ki taraf se apni zaat ka taaruf hai.
sections.study_note: Dhyan do: Bismillah mein 'bi' (with) hai — yani hum Allah ke naam ke saath shuru karte hain, na ke uske naam se alag. Alhamdulillah mein 'al' (the) hai — yani tamam tareefein, koi tareef bhi Allah se bahar nahi.

sections.summary: Ye ek turning point hai. Yahan tak baat Allah ke baare mein thi, ab baat banda aur Allah ke rishte ki hai. Ibadah aur madad — dono sirf Allah ke liye.
sections.study_note: 'Iyyaka' (sirf tujhe) ko pehle rakha gaya hai — Arabic mein isko 'hasr' kehte hain, yani kisi cheez ko sirf ek ke liye khaas karna. Ye tauheed ka sab se saaf elaan hai.

ayahs.roman_urdu: Allah ke naam se jo bada meherban, nihayat reham wala hai.
ayahs.english_meaning: In the Name of Allah — the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.
ayahs.simple: Hum har kaam Allah ke naam se shuru karte hain. Ye batata hai ke hum akela nahi hain — humein Allah ki madad chahiye. Aur Allah 'Rahman' hai — uski rahmat sab ke liye aam hai, aur 'Rahim' hai — uski khaas rahmat momino ke liye.
ayahs.deep: Bismillah sirf ek formal word nahi hai — ye ek declaration hai ke main apni zaat se nahi, Allah ki zaat se shuru kar raha hoon. 'Bi' ka matlab hai 'ke zariye' ya 'ke saath'. Yani main Allah ke naam ko apna sahara bana raha hoon. 'Rahman' ka lafz 'rahm' se aaya hai, aur ye Allah ki zaat ka khaas naam hai jo sirf Allah ke liye istemal hota hai. Ye uski aisi rahmat hai jo har cheez par hai — momin, kafir, insan, jaanwar, paudha — sab par. 'Rahim' ka matlab hai 'nihayat reham wala', aur ye uski khaas rahmat hai jo sirf momino ke liye Akhirat mein zahir hogi. Isliye Bismillah mein Allah ki zaat ka taaruf hai aur uski rahmat ka yaqeen dilaya ja raha hai.
ayahs.main_message: Har kaam se pehle Allah ka naam lena chahiye — ye humein yaad dilata hai ke hum mukhtar nahi, Allah ke meherban hain.
ayahs.why_it_matters: Bismillah se shuru karna zindagi ke har pehlu mein barakah laata hai. Ye adaab sikhaata hai ke jab hum kuch karte hain to pehle uski ijazat aur madad maangte hain.

ayahs.grammar_rhetoric: 'Bismillah' mein 'bi' harf-e-jarr hai aur 'Allah' majrur hai — yani Allah ke naam ke zariye. 'Rahman' aur 'Rahim' dono 'rahm' se mushtaq hain — 'Rahman' mein mubalagha (intensity) zyada hai kyunki ye 'fa'lan' ke wazan par hai, aur 'Rahim' 'fa'il' ke wazan par. Isliye 'Rahman' ki rahmat qowat aur hadd mein zyada hai, aur 'Rahim' ki rahmat daimi aur amali hai. Ye dono sifaat mil kar Allah ki rahmat ki mukammal tasveer dikhati hain — ek jo sab par hai, ek jo momino par khaas hai.
ayahs.historical_context: Bismillah ka istemal Islam se pehle bhi Arab mein tha, lekin 'Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim' ki ye khaas shakal Quran ne di. Kuch riwayat ke mutabiq Bismillah Islam se pehle 'Bismika Allahumma' ke tor par istemal hoti thi, aur Islam ne ise mukammal kiya.
ayahs.history_evidence: Bismillah ka istemal pre-Islamic Arabia mein bhi tha, lekin 'Rahman' ka lafz jahan Allah ki rahmat ki aam aur khaas qismon ko dikhata hai, woh Quran ki khaas ta'leem hai. Iska koi direct archaeological evidence nahi hai kyunki ye ek textual aur aqidati cheez hai. History is not central to this ayah; no forced historical claim.

ayahs.what_it_does_not_mean: Iska matlab ye nahi hai ke Allah ka naam lene se kaam khud-ba-khud halal ho jata hai. Halal kaam hona chahiye, phir Allah ka naam lena chahiye. Ye jaadu ya mantar nahi hai.

qa.q: Kya Bismillah Quran ki alag ayat hai?
qa.a: Jumhur (majority) ke nazdeek Bismillah Al-Fatihah ki pehli ayat hai. Lekin kuch fuqaha ise surah ka hissa maante hain lekin alag ayat nahi. Namaz mein Bismillah padhna Sunnat hai, aur iska sawab hai.

qa.q: Bismillah har kaam se pehle padhni chahiye?
qa.a: Haan, jahan tak mumkin ho. Khaas tor par khane, peene, safar, aur namaz mein. Lekin har chhote kaam par padhna zaroori nahi — Sunnat hai.

Yani Allah sirf insanon ka Rabb nahi, balki har us cheez ka Rabb hai jo wajood rakhti hai. Isliye Alhamdulillah kehna ek bahut bada elaan hai — ye tasleem karta hai ke har cheez ka sahara Allah hai.

surah_conclusion.complete_summary: Surah Al-Fatihah Quran ki pehli surah hai, 7 ayat, Makki. Ye Quran ka khulasa hai — Tauheed, Risalat, Akhirat, Ibadah, aur Hidayat. Ye Allah ki tareef se shuru hoti hai, phir banda apna rukh Allah ki taraf karta hai, phir hidayat ki dua karta hai, aur akhir mein sahi raaste ki tafseel deti hai. Ye har namaz ki har rakat mein padhni hoti hai — iske bina namaz nahi hoti. Ye banda aur Allah ke darmiyan ek mukalma hai.
surah_conclusion.what_this_surah_teaches: Ye surah sikhati hai ke: (1) Har kaam Allah ke naam se shuru karo. (2) Har tareef Allah ke liye hai. (3) Allah Rahman aur Rahim hai. (4) Akhirat ka din Allah ke control mein hai. (5) Ibadah aur madad sirf Allah ke liye. (6) Hidayat sirf Allah se maango. (7) Sahi raasta ne'mat wale logon ka hai — na maghzub ka, na dhalleen ka.
surah_conclusion.why_this_surah_matters: Ye surah har namaz mein padhni hoti hai — agar nahi padhi to namaz nahi hoti. Ye Quran ka khulasa hai — poora Quran isme summarized hai. Ye Muslim ki zindagi ka sab se zyada padha jane wala kalima hai. Ye banda aur Allah ke darmiyan ek mukalma hai — har ayat ka jawab Allah deta hai.
surah_conclusion.what_i_should_understand: Mujhe samajhna chahiye ke: (1) Main mukhtar nahi — Allah par bharosa karna hai. (2) Meri ibadat aur meri madad sirf Allah ke liye honi chahiye. (3) Hidayat Allah ki ne'mat hai — iske liye har waqt dua karni chahiye. (4) Akhirat ka yaqeen rakhna chahiye. (5) Sahi raasta woh hai jo ne'mat wale logon ka hai.
surah_conclusion.what_i_should_do: (1) Har achhe kaam se pehle Bismillah padho. (2) Har ne'mat par Alhamdulillah kaho. (3) Allah ki rahmat par yaqeen rakho. (4) Akhirat ko yaad rakho. (5) Sirf Allah ki ibadat karo aur usse madad maango. (6) Hidayat ki dua karo. (7) Ilm aur amal dono ko apnao.
surah_conclusion.how_to_apply_it: Namaz mein Al-Fatihah padhte waqt khud ko samjho ke ye Allah se mukalma hai. Har ayat par ruk kar socho ke Allah kya jawab de raha hai. Namaz ke bahar bhi ye surah ki ta'leemat ko apni zindagi mein utaaro — Bismillah se shuru karo, Alhamdulillah kaho, Allah se madad maango, hidayat ki dua karo.
surah_conclusion.why_apply_it: Kyunki ye surah har namaz mein padhni hoti hai. Agar hum iska matlab samjhenge, to namaz mein khushu aayegi. Aur agar hum iski ta'leemat apnayenge, to hamari zindagi mein barakah aayegi — sukoon, qana'at, aur hidayat.
surah_conclusion.what_to_avoid: (1) Ghair-Allah se aisi madad maangna jo sirf Allah ke ikhtiyar mein hai. (2) Akhirat ko bhoolna. (3) Ilm ke bagair amal karna ya amal ke bagair ilm. (4) Doosron ko 'maghdub' ya 'dallin' kehna. (5) Hidayat ko apni mehnat ka natija samajhna.
